roadmap.title: Base camp and basics
roadmap.description: Set up a flame altar, craft your first tools, get a glider and grappling hook, and spend your first skill point.

roadmap.title: Springlands and the first elixir well
roadmap.description: Clear the first elixir well north of Longkeep, then finish the Springlands collectibles.

roadmap.title: Revelwood and Pikemead's Reach
roadmap.description: Collect the five Guard of the North pieces, beat the Fell Wispwyvern, take the Ghost Glider, and finish the Revelwood collectibles.

roadmap.title: Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes
roadmap.description: Finish the collectibles in both biomes as your level climbs.

roadmap.title: Albaneve Summits
roadmap.description: Finish the Albaneve collectibles and defeat the Fell Dragon Youngling.

roadmap.title: Veilwater Basin
roadmap.description: Finish the last biome collectibles and reach level 45.

achievements.description: Defeat the guardian of the first elixir well.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Fell Thunderbrute} in the first @mechanic{Elixir Well}.

steps.text: Go to the @mechanic{Elixir Well} in the @mechanic{Shroud} north of @loc{Longkeep}.
Defeat the @enemy{Fell Thunderbrute} inside.

achievements.description: Defeat the shroud wyvern.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Fell Wispwyvern}.

steps.text: Go to @loc{The Pike}, the castle courtyard at the north end of @loc{Pikemead's Reach}.
Defeat the @enemy{Fell Wispwyvern}.
When it roars to summon @enemy{Fell Beetles}, hit it in the mouth to stun it.
steps.note: A stunned boss takes extra damage.

achievements.description: Find all forgotten "guard of the north" armor pieces.
achievements.summary: Collect all five @item{Guard of the North} armor pieces.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Pikemead's Reach} in @loc{Revelwood}.
Open the @loc{Gold Chest} in @loc{The Pike} for the helmet and the one in @loc{Imperial Gardens} for the chestplate.
Open the @loc{Gold Chest} in @loc{Huckster Square} for the gloves and the one in @loc{Pike's Port} for the pants.
Open the @loc{Gold Chest} in @loc{Shanty Shacks} for the boots.

achievements.description: Create a flame altar.
achievements.summary: Place a @item{Flame Altar} in the world.

steps.text: Accept @mechanic{Claim A Spot For Your Base} as a quest. That unlocks the altar recipe.
Craft a @item{Flame Altar} by hand from 5 of any @item{Stone}, then place it where you want your base.

achievements.description: Craft or obtain a glider.
achievements.summary: Craft or obtain a @item{Glider}.

steps.text: At a @mechanic{Workbench}, craft the @item{Glider} from 8 @item{Shroud Wood}, 2 @item{Animal Fur}, 2 @item{String} and 2 @item{Shroud Spores}.

achievements.description: Craft or obtain a grappling hook.
achievements.summary: Craft or obtain a @item{Grappling Hook}.

guide.context: The Blacksmith quest @mechanic{Grappling Hook} also asks you to craft this item.

steps.text: Defeat a @enemy{Fell} enemy until it drops @item{Shroud Spores}. This unlocks the recipe.
At a @mechanic{Workbench}, craft the @item{Grappling Hook} from 4 @item{Metal Scraps}, 7 @item{String} and 10 @item{Shroud Spores}.

achievements.description: Craft a simple item.
achievements.summary: Craft an @item{Axe} or a @item{Pickaxe}.

steps.text: Craft either an @item{Axe} or a @item{Pickaxe}.

achievements.description: Obtain a ghost glider.
achievements.summary: Obtain the @item{Ghost Glider}.

guide.context: The Alchemist quest @mechanic{Among The Bluejays} also sends you to this chest.

steps.text: Go to the south-east @loc{Sun Temple} and climb to the top.
Open the @loc{Gold Chest} at the top to get the @item{Ghost Glider}.

achievements.description: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Springlands.
achievements.summary: Discover all @loc{Flame Shrines} and @loc{Flame Sanctums} across the Springlands.

steps.text: After speaking to @npc{The Flame} at the spire, interact with the Springlands obelisks. Each one marks shrines on your map.
Walk up to each @loc{Flame Shrine} and @loc{Flame Sanctum} and interact with its flame.

steps.text: Break a deposit of each material in the Springlands: @item{Flintstone} and @item{Salt}.

achievements.description: Mine terrain for the first time.

steps.text: Dig up @item{Springlands Dirt} or break @item{Stone}.

achievements.description: Read all obelisks in the Springlands.
achievements.summary: Read every @loc{Ancient Obelisk} in the Springlands.

guide.context: Each obelisk you read also reveals Shroud Roots and Flame Shrines across the biome.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{The Flame} at the summit of the @loc{Ancient Spire - Springlands}. This marks the obelisks on your map.
Visit each marked @loc{Ancient Obelisk} in the Springlands and interact with it.

guide.context: Each level-up gives 2 @mechanic{Skill Points}, so you will have some after your first level.

steps.text: Open the skill tree and unlock any skill with a @mechanic{Skill Point}.

achievements.description: Reached an ancient spire in the Springlands.
achievements.summary: Reach the top of the ancient spire in the Springlands.

guide.context: Speaking to The Flame also unlocks the spire as a fast travel point.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Ancient Spire - Springlands}.
Climb through its puzzles, doors and traps to the top.
Speak to @npc{The Flame} at the top.

achievements.summary: Clear the first @mechanic{Elixir Well} by chopping down its @mechanic{Shroud Root}.

steps.text: Go to the large @mechanic{Shroud} area north of @loc{Longkeep}. The quest @mechanic{The Blacksmith's Request} marks the well.
Defeat the @enemy{Fell Thunderbrute} that guards the well.
Chop down the @mechanic{Shroud Root} at the bottom of the well.

achievements.summary: Clear every @mechanic{Shroud Root} in the Springlands.

steps.text: After speaking to @npc{The Flame} at the spire, interact with the Springlands obelisks. Each one marks roots on your map.
Go to each @mechanic{Shroud Root} and chop it down. Roots inside an @mechanic{Elixir Well} count too.

achievements.description: Defeat the dragon.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Fell Dragon Youngling}.

guide.context: The dragon takes reduced damage unless it is stunned.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Howling Peak} in the @loc{Albaneve Summits}. The quest @mechanic{Slaying The Corrupted Beast} leads there.
Fill the dragon's stun bar with @item{Stun Arrows} or lightning spells such as @item{Chain Lightning}. You can also deflect its @mechanic{Fell Fire Meteors} back at it.
Move to the far side of the platform.
steps.note: The dragon leans its head back before it breathes fire.

steps.text: When it falls to the ground, attack it as much as possible. Repeat the stun and attack cycle until it is defeated.
